top_signals.title: Westport becomes Aetherion, bets on CNG for US long-haul
top_signals.summary:
Westport Fuel Systems is now Aetherion Technologies. CEO Dan Sceli said the rename follows a narrower strategy built on HPDI and the Cespira joint venture with Volvo.

The post Westport becomes Aetherion, bets on CNG for US long-haul appeared first on FreightWaves.

top_signals.title: Lufthansa Says ‘Couldn’t Miss’ TAP Deal Has €450 Million Upside
top_signals.summary: Deutsche Lufthansa AG outlined the benefits of a “couldn’t miss” opportunity to buy a minority stake in Portuguese airline TAP SA, including catching up with European rivals in Latin America and finding as much as €450 million ($505 million) in annual synergies.
